sourceArticle.title: No Claude Fable 5? No problem: Sakana achieves frontier performance with new Fugu multi-model, auto synthesis system
sourceArticle.author: Carl Franzen

athenaOutput.directive: Establish an autonomous, self-hosted Model Synthesis Loop (Project HARNESS-SYNTH) that combines Sakana-style evolutionary model merging with agentic Self-Harness rewriting, ensuring the Creative Liberation Engine achieves sovereign frontier performance without external API dependency.
athenaOutput.rationale: To maintain absolute sovereignty (Article I) and bypass the need for closed-source frontier models like Claude Fable 5, the Creative Liberation Engine must possess its own mechanism for generating state-of-the-art capabilities. By combining the 'Self-Harness' framework (where agents write their own evaluation suites) with Sakana's Fugu evolutionary model merging, we create a closed-loop self-improvement engine. The synthesized models rewrite their own evaluation harnesses, which in turn drive the evolutionary selection and merging of the next generation of models.

options.title: Project HARNESS-SYNTH (Active Self-Harness Evolution)
options.description: Integrate agentic self-harness rewriting with evolutionary parameter-space merging. Models rewrite their own validation and evaluation harnesses, which then serve as the dynamic fitness landscape for Sakana-style multi-model synthesis.
options.tradeoffs: Highest capability upside and complete architectural sovereignty, but requires complex orchestration of the feedback loop to prevent reward hacking or degradation of base capabilities.

options.title: Project FUGU-GENESIS (Sovereign Local Synthesis Pipeline)
options.description: Build a fully automated pipeline that continuously pulls local open-source weights (Llama, Qwen, Mistral) and runs evolutionary merges to optimize for specific Creative Liberation Engine sub-tasks.
options.tradeoffs: Highly predictable and direct control over task-specific performance, but lacks the dynamic self-improvement loop of self-harnessing.

options.title: Project CHAMELEON (Dynamic On-Demand Merging)
options.description: Synthesize custom model merges dynamically in GPU memory at runtime based on incoming request metadata, using a lightweight routing network to blend weights on-the-fly.
options.tradeoffs: Zero storage overhead for pre-merged models and extreme flexibility, but introduces cold-start latency during dynamic weight blending.

options.title: Project SWARM-MERGE (Decentralized Weight Exchange)
options.description: Deploy a peer-to-peer framework across distributed edge nodes running local evolutionary merging cycles, sharing successful DNA (merge recipes) to collectively evolve a frontier-grade model.
options.tradeoffs: Massive scale and resilience, but introduces significant bandwidth overhead and complex synchronization of evolutionary epochs across nodes.

options.title: Project CONSTITUTIONAL-EVOLUTION (Ethics-Driven Synthesis)
options.description: Utilize constitutional compliance as the primary fitness function in the evolutionary loop, ensuring synthesized models are mathematically aligned with the Creative Liberation Engine's core tenets.
options.tradeoffs: Guarantees highly aligned and safe models, but may constrain the creative capability exploration of the evolutionary search space.

options.title: Project CLOSED-API DEPENDENCY (External Frontier Orchestration)
options.description: Rely entirely on external closed APIs (such as OpenAI or Anthropic) for frontier-level reasoning, orchestrating them via complex prompt engineering and routing.
options.tradeoffs: Low initial engineering effort, but completely violates Article I (Sovereignty), exposes the engine to external downtime, API changes, and data leakage.
